context:
## Student Accommodation System

A university accommodation management system with Spring Boot backend and Angular frontend.
Manages student housing applications, room allocations, documents, and notifications.

### Tech Stack
- **Backend**: Spring Boot 3.5.7, Java 17, Gradle 8.11.1
- **Frontend**: Angular 21 with Material Design
- **Database**: PostgreSQL 16.2 with Flyway migrations (V{YYYY_MM_DD_HHMM}__description.sql)
- **Storage**: MinIO for file uploads
- **Authentication**: JWT tokens with Spring Security
- **API Docs**: SpringDoc OpenAPI (Swagger UI at /swagger-ui.html)
- **Feature Flags**: FF4j

### Backend Package Structure (com.beezhub.student_accommodation)
- controller/ ΓåÆ REST endpoints by domain
- service/ ΓåÆ Business logic layer
- repository/ ΓåÆ Spring Data JPA (extends JpaRepository, JpaSpecificationExecutor)
- model/entity/ ΓåÆ JPA entities
- model/dto/ ΓåÆ Request/Response DTOs (never expose entities in API)
- model/enums/ ΓåÆ Enumerations (ApplicationStatus, RoomType, etc.)
- mapper/ ΓåÆ MapStruct for entity-DTO conversion
- security/ ΓåÆ JWT auth, user details, filters
- config/ ΓåÆ Configuration classes
- exceptions/ ΓåÆ Custom exceptions
- specification/ ΓåÆ JPA Specifications for dynamic filtering
- validation/ ΓåÆ Custom validators

### Frontend Module Structure (frontend/src/app)
- features/auth/ ΓåÆ Login, signup, password reset, email verification
- features/admin/ ΓåÆ Admin dashboard and management (buildings, rooms, applications, allocations)
- features/student/ ΓåÆ Student-specific features
- features/dashboard/ ΓåÆ Student dashboard (applications, documents, profile)
- core/ ΓåÆ Services, guards, interceptors, models
- shared/ ΓåÆ Reusable components

### Key Patterns & Conventions
- **Database**: Enums stored as strings, no soft deletes, Flyway manages all schema changes
- **Security**: JWT stateless, role-based (@PreAuthorize), admin tokens 4h, student tokens 10h
- **Async**: Email sending via @Async, batch allocation on scheduled intervals
- **Validation**: Jakarta Bean Validation on DTOs, Angular reactive forms mirror backend rules
- **Testing**: JUnit + Jacoco for backend, Jasmine/Karma for frontend, target >80% coverage
- **MapStruct**: Auto-generates entity-DTO mappers (rebuild after entity/DTO changes)

### Development Commands
- Backend: `cd backend && ./gradlew bootRun` (port 8080)
- Frontend: `cd frontend && npm start` (port 4200)
- Docker: `docker-compose up --build` (full stack)
- Tests: `./gradlew test` (backend), `npm test` (frontend)
- Lint: `npm run lint` (frontend), `npm run lint:fix` (auto-fix)

### Domain Entities
- app_user, student ΓåÆ Users and profiles
- application ΓåÆ Housing applications with preferences
- room_allocation, staged_allocation ΓåÆ Room assignments (staged = pending review)
- building, room, building_image ΓåÆ Physical infrastructure
- document ΓåÆ Uploaded files (MinIO storage)
- notification, user_notification ΓåÆ Email tracking
- allocation_rule ΓåÆ Scoring algorithm rules
- waiting_list_entry ΓåÆ Waitlist management
- academic_year, institution, year_of_study ΓåÆ Reference data
- activity_log ΓåÆ Audit trail
- system_setting ΓåÆ Config key-value pairs

### Integration Points
- **MinIO**: Document storage with signed URLs
- **Email**: SMTP with retry logic, async processing
- **Google Maps API**: Geocoding for building addresses
